role: Independent read-only arithmetic and recorded-data audit; no engine searches, builds, tests, benchmark reruns or tracked edits. Does not import the benchmark summarizer or guard implementation.
limits: Matching recorded score/move/nodes/PV/depth/TT fields supports unchanged observed search behavior; no full visited-tree hash exists.

Wall time includes UCI reset/transaction and excludes process startup. At millisecond scales host scheduling and transport noise remain; zero named external-engine CPU growth does not exclude other host work or unknown/transient engines.
Engine time has millisecond granularity; zero or missing engine-time ratios are omitted exactly as declared.

Fixed-depth same-work timing is separate from timed-game strength. The 7.17% clock-instrumented SEE share and 402 exact-value microprofile queries are earlier distinct measurements and are not counted as these 125 fixed-depth pairs.
No timing benefit should be claimed for every position or every individual sample.
